Hit Open the firehose. New posts trigger detuned reeds, replies call back through bone flutes, and likes and reposts beat the skin drums. Surges in activity swell the low drone and crowd the pipes into a frenzy.

You can mute individual voices, push the reverb, or record and download a performance. Demo plays from a simulated feed. I verified live playback and recording in the browser preview. The published instrument is private and opens with your ChatGPT sign-in.
